description: This file defines an 'Evaluate' callback class for use during model training, which performs evaluation on datasets at the end of each epoch, computes mean average precision (mAP), and optionally logs results to TensorBoard.

classes.name: Evaluate
classes.description: A Keras callback class for evaluating object detection models during training, computing mAP, and logging results.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the Evaluate callback with dataset generator, thresholds, and logging options.

methods.name: on_epoch_end
methods.description: Performs evaluation at the end of each epoch, computes average precisions, calculates mAP, and logs to TensorBoard if configured.
